subject: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Team —

I'm trying to get a concrete list of dependencies and expected exception flows before we lock the canary for the per-route economics (cost + latency) tile. Acme is keen to be an early canary and procurement is starting to ask questions, so we need to be explicit.

High-level asks:
- One-line list of telemetry/signals required (token counts, model variant id, batching metadata, KV cache hits, egress region, latency p50/p95)
- If telemetry is missing for a tenant, what should the tile show? (error, degraded view, placeholder, last-known)
- SLA/exception policy for tenant-level gaps — immediate fallback vs. scheduled backfill.
- Rollout gating checklist (feature flag, sampling rate, telemetry guardrails) and a proposed timeline for a canary with Acme.

Please reply with owners next to each bullet and attach any dependency matrix. If we can meet tomorrow, I'd like to lock the gating criteria.

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick pass below (owners in parens). I've attached a dependency matrix (obs-dep-matrix.xlsx) with signal owners and collection status.

Telemetry / signals (owner):
- Token counts (ingest pipeline) — Engineering: ingestion-team (Naomi)
- Model variant id per-inference (runtime) — Serving: runtime-team (Jasmine)
- Batching metadata (batch sizes, queue delay) — Serving: runtime-team (Jasmine)
- KV cache hits / misses (cache service) — Infra: cache-team (Marissa)
- P50 / P95 latency (tracing + sampler) — Observability: obs-team (Naomi)
- Region / egress tag (routing) — Platform: routing-team (Ben)
- Cost attribution keys (per-tenant mapping) — Billing: billing-team (Marissa) — this one is partially implemented, open question below.

Exception / degraded behavior options:
- If critical signals (token counts, variant id) are missing => show "Data not available" card + link to diagnostics and don't surface inferred cost. (owner: Naomi)
- If only sampling/traces are missing => show degraded percent (e.g., "estimated from sample") and an annotation explaining sampling rate. (owner: Naomi)
- For minor gaps (cache hit missing) => best-effort estimate and flag as "estimate". (owner: Marissa)

SLA / fallback policy:
- Immediate fallback to estimated view for read-only tiles (no billing impact) — okay for canary.
- For anything that affects billing chargebacks, require backfill within 48 hours or mark as "billing delayed" and notify finance. (owner: Marissa)

Rollout gating checklist (proposed):
1) Feature flag + per-tenant opt-in (runtime) — Jasmine — in 1 week
2) Telemetry health >= 95% for critical signals on canary tenants for 48h — Naomi
3) Sampling + UX degraded-state designs implemented — Jasmine + Naomi
4) Billing attribution validated on test tenants — Marissa
5) Security review & Acme procurement confirmation — Ben

I'm happy to walk through the matrix on a quick sync; I can be on a call today at 3pm PT.

Naomi
Staff Product, Observability

Attachment: obs-dep-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet — signal mapping, owners, collection status)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Quick UX/impl notes from runtime side:

- We can read model variant id and batching metadata from the request envelope; runtime-team already emits variant id to kafka but the field name changed between v1/v2 models. I'll add a migration mapping (owner: Jasmine).
- Sampling: default trace sampling at 1% won't give good P95 estimates for low-traffic tenants. For canary tenants we'll enable 10% sample for 48h behind the feature flag. (owner: runtime-team)
- UI constraints: showing both "estimated" and "exact" cost lines doubles the tile complexity. Suggest we have a single trend with a small badge indicating "estimated" when applicable; expanding the tile shows the provenance. I added a Figma frame for the compact badge (link below).

I'll update the feature flag playbook and link the UX frames. We should also add an audit event when we fall back to "estimate" so SRE + billing can query incidents.

Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/per-route-econ-tiles

— Jasmine
Lead Runtime Engineer, Observability Integrations

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Beth White <beth.white@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-13T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Beth — forwarding the dependency pass from the observability/product teams. Acme asked for per-route breakdowns and we're proposing a canary with you if you're open. High level: we'll opt you into a feature flag, increase sampling for the window, and display an "estimated" badge when necessary.

Beth, could you confirm these two procurement items so we can move to scheduling?
1) Acme needs SOC2 evidence (we can provide SOC2 report + audit log export)
2) Acme would like a dedicated one-week dashboard access window where we retain per-tenant traces for 30 days for debugging (temporary retention increase)

Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Beth White <beth.white@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Thanks Ben / Rishi —

Acme can be an early canary. A couple of constraints from procurement & security:
- We need the SOC2 report and a written confirmation on the temporary retention window (how long, where logs will be stored, and who has access). Proc wants an explicit data handling statement for the 30-day debug retention.
- Any feature that changes billing visibility needs a note in our contract amendments (we'll loop legal).

I'll attach our procurement checklist — please send the SOC2 and a short data handling note and procurement@acme-analytics.com will review.

Best,
Beth
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics

Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood@redwood.com>, Beth White <beth.white@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Per-route economics tile: dependency list, exception behavior, and rollout plan

Thanks everyone — good thread. Action items I pulled out:
- Naomi: finalize obs-dep-matrix and mark any signals <80% collection as "blocker". Deliver by EOD 5/15. (obs-dep-matrix.xlsx updated)
- Jasmine: add the variant-name migration mapping and update the feature-flag playbook to include 10% sampling toggle. Deliver PR + playbook link and add audit-event emission. Target: 5/18.
- Marissa: confirm billing attribution path for test tenants and document the backfill SLA wording for finance (48h). Deliver by 5/16.
- Ben: send SOC2 report + short data-handling note to procurement@acme-analytics.com and Rishi by EOD 5/15.
- Me (Rishi): schedule a 30-minute gating sync for 5/17 10am PT (invite sent) and raise JIRA-OPS-4721 for rollout tasks.

I'll keep Beth copied on progress for procurement. If we hit any blockers on signal collection, call it out in the matrix as "signal blocker" so Acme sees it up-front.

—Rishi
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
